author: Thoughty2
description:
In 1761, the French ship L’Utile wrecked on a tiny island in the Indian Ocean, leaving around 80 enslaved Malagasy people stranded there. The crew said ‘lol, see you later’ and sailed off into the sunset.

For the next 15 years, the survivors were left to fend for themselves on this tiny, barren island. They built shelters, made clothes from bird feathers and somehow managed to keep a fire burning using wood from the wreck.

When a rescue finally arrived in 1776, only seven women and an eight-month-old baby remained.

Fifteen years stranded on a tiny island, yet they never gave up. 

In the face of unimaginable circumstances, their resilience is genuinely extraordinary.
title: They Survived 15 Years on This Island
